zh.summary: 完善无边框窗口缩放与更新提示，更新运行环境和内置依赖。
highlights: 退出：停止和状态查询复用现有运行时位置，不再因新建缓存租约失败而卡住，并兼容旧版进程记录。
窗口：为插件提供透明边缘缩放接口，启用后移除原来的 4 像素边缘和残余系统描边。
更新：明确显示当前通道是否有可用更新，并补充 Portable 与内核离线更新包的获取说明。
运行环境：更新至 Node.js 24.22.1，修复应用依赖，并独立核验前端和包管理器的内联副本。
upgradeNotes: 正常退出应用后更新，并备份重要数据；升级保留会话、设置、凭据、插件和工作区。
通过完整 Portable 更新包或“从文件更新”升级；仅替换 EXE 不会升级内核、Node.js 和组件清单。
acknowledgements: 感谢 [@ArtificialAngels](https://github.com/ArtificialAngels) 在 [#201](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/issues/201) 提供无边框窗口反馈与缩放接口建议。

en.summary: Improves frameless resizing and update messages, and refreshes the runtime and bundled dependencies.
highlights: Exit: stopping and status checks reuse the existing runtime location, avoiding failures while creating an unnecessary cache lease and preserving compatibility with older process records.
Windows: exposes transparent edge resizing to plugins, removing the previous four-pixel margin and remaining system outline when enabled.
Updates: reports availability within the selected channel and clarifies where to obtain Portable and core packages for offline updates.
Runtime: updates to Node.js 24.22.1, repairs application dependencies and separately verifies copies embedded in the frontend and package manager.
upgradeNotes: Exit normally and back up important data before upgrading. Sessions, settings, credentials, plugins and the workspace are preserved.
Use a complete Portable update package or Update from file. Replacing only the EXE does not upgrade the core, Node.js or component manifest.
acknowledgements: Thanks to [@ArtificialAngels](https://github.com/ArtificialAngels) for the frameless-window feedback and resizing-interface proposal in [#201](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/issues/201).
